ой-блины-мои-блины.sr: Šaljiva pesma o palačinkama koje niko ne želi, svinji koju boli stomak, devojci preko reke i mačku koji se oženio.
ой-блины-мои-блины.en: A comic song about unwanted pancakes, a pig with a stomachache, a girl across the river and a cat's wedding.

как-на-масляной-неделе-блины-2.sr: Vesela priča o gošćenju kod kumova tokom Maslenice: četvoro pojede dvesta palačinki, a jedan gost jaše svinju s balalajkom.
как-на-масляной-неделе-блины-2.en: A merry story about visiting friends during Maslenitsa: four people eat two hundred pancakes, and a guest rides a pig carrying a balalaika.

квашня.sr: Testo oživi, prođe kroz kuću i izbije vrata. Kuma ispeče gomile palačinki, a gosti ih sve pojedu.
квашня.en: The dough comes alive, crosses the house and breaks down the door. A woman bakes piles of pancakes and the guests eat them all.

агу-вясна-закличка-весны.sr: Obredna pesma na beloruskom dijalektu doziva proleće i pita šta donosi: palačinke staricama, vence devojkama i jaja deci.
агу-вясна-закличка-весны.en: A Belarusian-dialect spring invocation asking what spring brings: pancakes for old women, wreaths for girls and eggs for children.

а-мы-масленицу-дожидаем.sr: Ljudi iščekuju Maslenicu, gledaju kroz prozor i dočekuju je sirom, maslacem i planinom palačinki. Mole je da ostane duže.
а-мы-масленицу-дожидаем.en: People await Maslenitsa, watch from the window and welcome her with cheese, butter and a mountain of pancakes. They beg her to stay longer.

масленица-я-гуляю.sr: Pesma slavi veselje, ali se i šaljivo žali što Maslenica odlazi, ostavljajući ljude bez sira, maslaca, jaja i hleba.
масленица-я-гуляю.en: The song celebrates revelry but playfully complains that Maslenitsa is leaving, taking cheese, butter, eggs and bread with her.

чижик.sr: Niz šaljivih stihova o čiožku, Katji, mladom oficiru i vezu; završava pozivom na ples i izbor partnera.
чижик.en: A sequence of playful verses about a siskin, Katya, a young officer and embroidery; it ends by inviting dancers to choose a partner.

бела-рыба.sr: Bela riba izvađena iz vode poredi se sa ženom odvojenom od dragog. Pesma prati njenu tugu, susret i šale, pa se vraća slici uzburkanog mora.
бела-рыба.en: A white fish taken from the water is compared with a woman separated from her beloved. The song follows her sorrow, reunion and playful teasing, returning to the image of the troubled sea.

бычок.sr: Posle široke Maslenice pripovedač ide na vašar, kupuje svilu, pravi povodac za bika i vodi ga trgovcima.
бычок.en: After Broad Maslenitsa, the narrator goes to the fair, buys silk, makes a rope for a bull and takes it to the merchants.

явор.sr: Pesma traži majčin blagoslov za doček proleća i ispraćaj zime. Priziva rodnu zemlju, bogatu žetvu, pite, pivo i svadbe; ponavlja se slika zelenog javora.
явор.en: The song asks a mother's blessing to welcome spring and bid winter farewell. It invokes fertile land, abundant grain, pies, beer and marriages, with a recurring image of the green maple.

подай-боже-ключик.sr: Molba Bogu za ključ kojim se otključava proleće i zaključava zima. Zima odlazi na sankama, proleće dolazi čamcem, leto kočijom.
подай-боже-ключик.en: A prayer for the key to unlock spring and lock away winter. Winter departs on a sledge, spring arrives in a boat and summer in a carriage.

блааслави-мати-вясну-закликати.sr: Devojke pletu vence i uz majčin blagoslov dozivaju proleće, ispraćaju zimu i dočekuju leto.
блааслави-мати-вясну-закликати.en: Girls weave wreaths and, with their mother's blessing, call spring, bid winter farewell and welcome summer.

а-мы-масляницу-провожали.sr: Ljudi se opraštaju od Maslenice, simbolično je sahranjuju i obećavaju da će je ponovo iskopati i dočekati sledeće godine.
а-мы-масляницу-провожали.en: People bid Maslenitsa farewell, symbolically bury her and promise to dig her up and welcome her again next year.

масляница-обманщица.sr: Uzvik pri spaljivanju lutke: Maslenica nas je prevarila jer je veselje prekratko. Zima treba da ode i pošalje proleće.
масляница-обманщица.en: A chant during the burning of the effigy: Maslenitsa has deceived us by ending the festivities too soon. Winter should leave and send Spring.

прощай-масляница.sr: Oproštaj od Maslenice u nedelju, posle dana provedenih na sankanju. Pesma poziva praznik da se vrati sledeće godine.
прощай-масляница.en: Farewell to Maslenitsa on Sunday after days of sledging. The song asks the festival to return next year.
